directAnswer: EV charging may fail due to issues with the charger, the vehicle's charging port, or the power source. Ensure all components are compatible and functioning properly.
summary: Identifying why your EV charging isn't working can involve checking various components, including the charger, vehicle, and power supply.

sections.heading: Charger Compatibility
sections.body: Ensure that the charger you are using is compatible with your EV model. Some EVs require specific chargers or adapters.

sections.heading: Charging Port Issues
sections.body: Inspect the charging port on your EV for any debris or damage. A dirty or damaged port can prevent a proper connection.

sections.heading: Power Source Check
sections.body: Verify that the power source is functioning. Try plugging in another device to see if it receives power. If using a public charging station, check for any alerts or issues reported.

steps.title: Check Charger Compatibility
steps.detail: Use a USB‑C / charger compatibility checker tool to confirm that your charger is suitable for your EV.

steps.title: Inspect Charging Port
steps.detail: Clean the charging port gently with a soft cloth and check for any visible damage.

steps.title: Test Power Source
steps.detail: Plug another device into the same outlet to ensure it is providing power. If using a public charger, look for any operational status indicators.

faqs.question: What should I do if my EV still won't charge?
faqs.answer: If charging issues persist, contact your vehicle manufacturer or a certified technician for further diagnosis.

faqs.question: Can weather affect EV charging?
faqs.answer: Yes, extreme temperatures can impact battery performance and charging efficiency. Ensure your EV is in a suitable environment.

faqs.question: Is it safe to use a different charger?
faqs.answer: Using a different charger is safe only if it is compatible with your EV model. Always check specifications before using an alternative charger.

caveats: Compatibility issues may vary based on EV model and charger type.
